name: MorphGate request header transforms
description: MorphGate upstream key (optional): a static x-mg-upstream-key header that the Edge requires when edge.toml sets upstream_keys. Replace the placeholder with values[0] printed by `mgctl keys gen-upstream`; never commit the real value. Template: adapters/cloudflare/README.md.

rules.description: MorphGate: static x-mg-upstream-key for the Edge's upstream key check. The value is a secret: set it in the dashboard or API only, rotate with mgctl keys gen-upstream --rotate (the Edge accepts the current and the previous value).

x-mg-upstream-key.value: REPLACE-ME with values[0] from mgctl keys gen-upstream
